description: This source file contains functions for managing style settings within the lu5_State structure, including push, pop, and clear operations on a style stack.

methods.name: void lu5_style_push(lu5_State * l5,lu5_style_setting * style)
methods.description: Pushes a style setting onto the style stack within lu5_State, allocating memory for the new style and incrementing the stack length.

methods.name: void lu5_style_pop(lu5_State * l5)
methods.description: Pops the top style setting from the style stack, frees associated memory, and decrements the stack length.

methods.name: void lu5_style_clear(lu5_State * l5)
methods.description: Clears all style settings from the stack, freeing memory and setting pointers to NULL.
